name: E2EE Lite
description: Lightweight end-to-end encryption for Discord on Valenced, compatible with the Aegires Android app (Aegires v2: Argon2id, AES-GCM). Encrypts and decrypts text, images, GIFs, videos, audio and files with a shared password. Settings: set the encryption key and pick the encryption preset. An E2EE button in the chat header switches encryption per chat, decrypted messages get a lock icon, and videos and audio play in the chat.
author: Legitbhaidark (https://github.com/Legitbhaidark "GitHub"), based on Aegires E2EE by Dark (https://github.com/system32crowdstrikewin11 "GitHub")
